description: This file contains test helper functions and mock implementations for channel messaging adapters, including parsing and normalization functions for Telegram and WhatsApp targets, and factory functions for creating test plugins and registries.

methods.name: parseTelegramTargetForTest
methods.description: Parses a raw Telegram target string to extract chat ID, message thread ID, and chat type.

methods.name: normalizeWhatsAppTargetForTest
methods.description: Normalizes a raw WhatsApp target string to E.164 format or group JID.

methods.name: createWhatsAppResolveTarget
methods.description: Creates a resolver function for WhatsApp targets, returning normalized target or error.

methods.name: createTelegramResolveTarget
methods.description: Creates a resolver function for Telegram targets, returning chat ID or error.

methods.name: createTestChannelPlugin
methods.description: Factory function to create a test channel plugin with specified parameters.

methods.name: createTelegramTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a test plugin for Telegram channel.

methods.name: createWhatsAppTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a test plugin for WhatsApp channel.

methods.name: createNoopOutboundChannelPlugin
methods.description: Creates a no-operation outbound channel plugin for specified IDs (discord, imessage, slack).

methods.name: createTargetsTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test registry with specified plugins, defaulting to WhatsApp and Telegram test plugins.
